name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Grilled Chicken Breast Sandwich (Pechuga de Pollo)
whyItWorks: Citrus-marinated grilled chicken breast served on crusty Cuban bread with mayo. Lean, tender, and unbreaded poultry provides clean park nutrition.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Pechuga de Pollo sandwich on Cuban bread with mayo; request no raw mojo onions.
